sql: SELECT c.name, c.slug, c.is_active, (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_leads l WHERE l.company_id = c.id AND l.created_at > now() - interval '30 days') AS leads30, (SELECT count(*) FROM wapi_instances i WHERE i.company_id = c.id) AS instancias, (SELECT count(*) FROM company_events e WHERE e.company_id = c.id AND e.created_at > now() - interval '30 days') AS festas30, (SELECT count(*) FROM user_companies u WHERE u.company_id = c.id) AS usuarios, (SELECT max(a.created_at)::date FROM activity_logs a WHERE a.company_id = c.id) AS ult_atividade, (SELECT string_agg(k, ',') FROM jsonb_each(coalesce(c.settings -> 'enabled_modules', '{}'::jsonb)) AS m(k, v) WHERE v = 'true'::jsonb) AS modulos FROM companies c ORDER BY 4 DESC
